title: MOOR Pulse Luxe Spatial UI
target: Project Pulse + embedded Pulse tools + Funnel Environment

page0.request: Apply the visual feeling of the provided unloaded Verse screen literally across Pulse: deep black/navy spatial field, hovering surfaces, bright white/ice-blue light, emerald accents, convincing depth, clean mobile interaction; show the current Funnel in the same 3D configuration; do not generate a picture—build the actual UI and 3D result.

intent: Make Pulse feel like one premium spatial instrument rather than stacked web panels. Preserve function and information density while removing chrome collision on mobile.
visualLaws: The background is a continuous deep spatial field, not a flat card canvas.
Primary light is white to ice blue; emerald is reserved for live/success/authorized state.
Chrome floats. It never occupies more space than the control requires.
Edges are hairline luminous strokes; large opaque borders and heavy filled panels are removed.
Surfaces use subtle blur, specular top-edge light and deep shadow to create convincing depth.
The hero content is visually dominant; navigation and command controls recede until touched.
No purple/pink visual identity in the core shell.
Text is bright neutral white with cool muted secondary copy.
Motion is short and mechanical; no decorative wobble or continuous gratuitous animation.

shell.topRail: Floating, safe-area-aware rail. Brand/location is one pill; secondary actions are compact circular controls.
shell.workspace: Full-bleed spatial field. Open tools float in it rather than sitting inside a boxed dashboard.
shell.commandDock: Request bar floats above the bottom nav. No overlap. Touch target >=44px.
shell.bottomDock: Compact icon dock with active ice-blue point light; safe-area aware.
shell.mobile: No horizontal chrome collisions; no hidden controls behind home indicator; tool content gets the full remaining viewport.

css: large low-opacity radial light pools behind glass
subtle micro-grid/noise via CSS gradients only
background depth fade rather than card fill

funnelView.requirement: Current Funnel architecture must be directly visible as 3D finite geometry—nodes, lines, cones, layers—with the same visual system.
funnelView.currentLaw: Ultra Funnel Law candidate (Secure Core / Elastic Society) remains shown as candidate beside v44 until promotion.

mobileAcceptance: At 390–430px CSS width, top chrome does not overlap or clip.
Request bar and bottom dock never overlap.
The visible workspace remains unobstructed between top rail and command dock.
Embedded same-origin tools inherit the Luxe shell automatically.
Funnel Environment is usable by touch and fills the viewport.
No horizontal page overflow is introduced.
functionalAcceptance: Existing Funnel v44/Harness checks still pass.
Ultra candidate receipt and law files remain discoverable in Pulse.
The current Funnel graph renders and can be traced.
No image generation is part of runtime.
nonGoals: Do not replace application-specific content with decorative sci-fi art.
Do not promote Ultra over v44 as part of this UI task.
Do not hide required information merely to make the interface sparse.
